notes.title: Last few days of Thieves of Dingirra crowdfunding!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/thieves-of-dingirra?ref=3sbfmz]Kickstarter campaign for our next fantasy game Thieves of Dingirra[/url] is about to end! The game was fully funded and we already reached some interesting stretch goals, such as elf race added, triad ending with the two furry characters, and so on.
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/thieves-of-dingirra?ref=3sbfmz][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/104054b5e12c12de038f19874c73b93fd2b98e5c.png[/img][/url]

But there are a few more which we'd love to include in the final game. They are:

[h1]Extra CGs[/h1]

This will add more CG artwork (and corresponding scenes in the story) beside the ones already planned, like the one below between Abu and female human protagonist:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/thieves-of-dingirra?ref=3sbfmz][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/71732f0cc0a0b3613446622a49189489bfc43a3c.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Bonus romance scenes[/h1]

A popular request was to have bonus scenes after flirting with a character and after you "lock in" your romance. So that the romance arc doesn't end abruptly after you successfully unlock each character love scene.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/thieves-of-dingirra?ref=3sbfmz][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/5a7b857d6df7e2eeec81cd71584426d866780c3c.png[/img][/url]

An extra goal which we're planning to add if there's time, is:

[h1]Bonus one-night stand[/h1]

Since in the game there's this brothel run by Yasemin, the Traveler's Delight, some backers suggested a potential one-night stand with some of the "entertainers" of that place.

That's all for now, for more information about the game please [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/thieves-of-dingirra?ref=3sbfmz]visit the Thieves Of Dingirra's campaign page[/url]!

notes.title: Tales From The Under-Realm: Lilith is now out!
notes.content:
We're pleased to announce that our latest dark fantasy yuri visual novel is out:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2896520/Tales_From_The_UnderRealm_Lilith/

It's the final chapter of the Tales From The Under-Realm series, and the game features:
- animated intro movie
- full OST with theme song
- a long story of 140.000 words
- four optional one-night stand scenes
- two love interests (Evelyn and Odette)
- bonus unlockable pin-ups
- over 50 CGs! and 5 different endings

It's the biggest game we've ever done at this price, and if you try it you'll agree. It has optional very spicy adult content, so if you like that be sure to try it!

notes.title: ToA: An Elven Marriage coming to Steam the 16th!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that the first Loren spin-off, ToA: An Elven Marriage, will come to Steam the 16th of current month!

To find more info about the game and wishlist it, please visit the page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1629210/Tales_Of_Aravorn_An_Elven_Marriage/

[b]Features[/b]
- four love interests: continue previous romance with Myrth and Rei, or romance Lydia and Nathir
- LGBTQ friendly, offering both straight and homosexual romances, and featuring a non-binary secondary character, Gruff
- 195,000 words of plot (Loren had 230,000 including the DLC)
- branching plot with quest offering different outcomes
- 4 different possible outcomes of the main storyline, with a 5th "secret" happy ending
- the classic turn based, party RPG combat system with front and back row is back
- every legendary weapon and accessory has a unique skill/spell, offering an incredible variety of builds
- simplified potion crafting and item upgrading


this and much more! Stay tuned for a discount on Loren The Amazon Princess next week to celebrate!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/e7976157b61306c39e9418fbce67bb977c18c59e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: At Your Feet (my new Kickstarter)
notes.content:
I've just launched my new Kickstarter for a foot fetish yuri dating sim called "At Your Feet": https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/at-your-feet

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/at-your-feet]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2717761/f5030ccfe4444fee3e0aceac8417cde22119383d.jpg[/img][/url]

It's one of the craziest ideas to date, but after so many "serious" games I wanted to do something more silly/funny. Maybe I went a bit too far lol

For those not into feet, the game will of course have more:
- many comedy moments
- usual romance build up. Even if will be a comedy, there'll be some more romantic scenes
- in the optional adult scenes, while the main focus will be on feet, there'll be also other stuff

For those "worried" about us changing into making only yuri games:
- I've put up the Curse Of Mantras game page, a game with ALL romance combos and 10 love interests
https://store.steampowered.com/app/618000/The_Curse_Of_Mantras/
- I'm making good progress with ToA: An Elven Marriage, the next chapter of Elenor/Saren saga which will feature all romance combos again

So more stuff is coming, but those are bigger games and they take a long time to make! Thanks for your patience :)

notes.title: Cursed Lands version 1.0.16
notes.content: fixed a bug that wasn't allowing to combat the zombies 5 times the first time you join the pirates, making the "Zombies Killer" achievement not possible

notes.title: Cursed Lands version 1.0.12
notes.content:
[b]What's New in Version 1.0.12[/b]

- added some more light bows usable by Leena
- when reloading a saved game, the Legendary items would be labeled Rare. Stats were unchanged, only the category
- fixed a super rare bug that could get you stuck early in the game (messagebox saying to visit Karen, but Karen option wasn't available in Citadel)

notes.title: Cursed Lands version 1.0.10
notes.content:
[b]What's New in Version 1.0.10[/b]

- Sylrissa Counter attack Expert level was still using the Journeyman effect (75% accuracy and 4 turns). Now this has been fixed
- Dasyra's Tree Of Life had a bug: if you casted again on a character who already had the effect, it would increase the duration, leading to issues like dealing damage instead of healing after 3 times. This is because how the skill was created must always last 3 turns and not more. Now the maximum duration will always be 3 turns, and it won't do damage anymore

notes.title: Cursed Lands version 1.0.9
notes.content:
[b]What's New in Version 1.0.9[/b]

- Vaeril's Life Channel skill was showing wrong values in the preview, and also was using 20% HP even at tier 2-3 (instead of 40% and 60%). Now it works as it should!
- added a "Relationship Screen" that can be accessed in the map clicking the heart-shaped icon. Will show your relationship with all the party members (remember that you have a relationship value even with characters you can't romance)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31461147/e1e81722fc9e5732a47c8afe33cf7f92692379c8.jpg[/img]
